# `apps/realmforge/modeler/ui/ModelerPanel.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/apps/realmforge/modeler/ui/ModelerPanel.js`

ModelerPanel.js — the Modeler's three-pane surface inside RealmForge. The interface is browseable-first (code is a secondary tab, not the front door): left   — preset/blueprint pickers, PAC3-style part TREE, AI recipes center — tabs: [3D View] engine-gizmo viewport with click-picking and ▶ motion playback · [Node Graph] paint-style part/wire editor right  — tabs: [Properties] PAC3 property grid (default) · [Source] ForgeSource, ForgeBehavior, and approved JavaScript bake source Everything is driven through ModelerSession, so AI tool edits appear here live and manual edits are visible to the AI's state tools. Gizmo drags preview through matrix recompute (composeTRS/applyGen — no vertex work) and commit as a normal patchPart, so drag edits land in the source like any other edit. CSP/Trusted-Types safe: createElement + textContent only.

## Functions

### `inferRealmForgeConstructionTemplateIntent(prompt, cards = listRealmForgeConstructionTemplateCards()`

Match only a complete, explicit request for a reviewed built-in template. Modifiers, questions, negation, and compound instructions deliberately fail closed because applying a stock template would not satisfy those requests.

### `projectRealmForgeLoadingTaskTelemetry(event, { sessionId = '' } = {})`

Project measured RealmForge loading stages into the shared content-free task contract.
